name: Daily steps
summary: Raise your daily steps with a gentle weekly ramp and walk slots on your calendar.

onboarding.prompt: About how many steps a day do you average now?
onboarding.reaction: That's your starting point, and it's a good one.

onboarding.prompt: What daily target would feel like a win?
onboarding.reaction: Love it. We'll ramp there week by week.
Walks are better with company. Or a good podcast.
Walk slots placed. Even 10 minutes counts.

phases.name: Warm up
benchmarks: Average steps up about 500 a day from baseline

phases.name: Ramp
benchmarks: Average steps up about 500 to 1,000 a day each week until target

plan_blueprint.calendar: Short walk slots on the chosen times each day, a longer weekend walk, and a weekly step target that ramps until the chosen goal.

approach_variants.habit: Walks attached to daily cues (after lunch, after dinner); streak of days on target.
approach_variants.willpower: Weekly step challenge and optional circle leaderboard for those who opt in.
approach_variants.time: Walks are calendar blocks; weekly review of minutes walked.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward at each new weekly target.
approach_variants.resource: Week one sorts comfortable shoes, a route list, rain options and a buddy.

guardrails: Talk to your doctor before starting. GoalKin offers education, not medical advice.
Increase gradually; if you feel pain or unusual breathlessness, stop and get checked.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A low day doesn't count against the week; the weekly average matters. A low week repeats the same target. After two weeks away, the target steps back to the last week you hit.
